Typical Cases of Full Mechanization for Specialty Economic Crops

Source: R/PubMachineCountyCase.R
PubMachineCountyCase.Rd

A data set containing typical cases of full-process mechanization for specialty economic crops (vegetables, fruit trees, tea, and medicinal herbs), compiled year by year from public notices of the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs https://www.moa.gov.cn, with wide data format.

Usage

PubMachineCountyCase

Format

A data frame:

year

integer, the data year aligned with the source file

batch

integer, the official batch number

category

character, the crop group (vegetables, fruit trees, tea, or medicinal herbs)

index

integer, the sequence number within the year and batch

order

integer, the sequence number within the crop group

title

character, the original case title in the public notice

province

character, province names in reduced chinese

place

character, city, county, or region parsed from the title

crop

character, crop or variety parsed from the title

Source

https://www.huhuaping.com/

Examples

# load data set
techme::PubMachineCountyCase
